Files in this directory are published to VitorHolandaI/perfo, the tree that
`omarchy plugin add` clones and that the Omarchy marketplace reviews.

README.md here is NOT the development README one directory up. The marketplace
maintainer blocked an earlier submission because the development README told
users to pipe install.sh from a mutable branch into bash
(omacom/omarchy-plugin-marketplace#4881). The published README documents only
`omarchy plugin add`, and must never grow a remote-script install path again.
